_description: Run prettier after Claude writes or edits a file. Skips files prettier doesn't handle.
_requires: prettier installed (npx prettier or local node_modules)
_test: echo '{"tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":"test.ts"}}' | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; npx prettier --write "$f" --ignore-unknown; }

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; npx prettier --write "$f" --ignore-unknown; } 2>/dev/null || true
